question.question_text: Which item was used more frequently by the camera wearer during the garden maintenance activity: the garden sprayer or the hose?

answer_options.text: The garden sprayer was used more frequently
The garden sprayer was not used, only the hose
Neither the garden sprayer nor the hose was used; the garden was maintained using different equipment
The hose was used more frequently
Both were used with the same frequency

shared_investigation.established_facts: The video contains multiple observations of a person holding a hose, indicating the use of the hose. However, there is no direct visual evidence of the garden sprayer being used. The frequency of use for either tool cannot be determined from the provided observations.
shared_investigation.gap_reason: The evidence does not provide a clear indication of the frequency of use of the garden sprayer compared to the hose. While the hose is frequently observed in use, the garden sprayer is not explicitly shown being used in any of the reviewed frames.
